description: Election Commission - Notice declaring K. K. G. P. Aruna Kantha  elected as a member of he Wanathavilluwa Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Wanathavilluwa Pradeshiya Sabha) due to resignation, specifically under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for declaring a new member, which falls under electoral processes and related matters as defined for Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
